test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase should indicate a future action **that is a requirement for the teachers' professional development.**
 
• **"Will be"** is appropriate because it indicates a definite expectation or requirement in the future.
 
• **"Shall be"** is too formal and less commonly used in contemporary English for such contexts.
 
• **"Can be"** suggests a possibility rather than a requirement, which is not suitable here.
 
• **"Would be"** is conditional and hypothetical, which does not fit the context of a mandatory requirement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1 (will be)**.

 

***Correct Sentence:*** *"Teachers will be given continuous opportunities for self-improvement and to learn the latest innovations and advances in their professions. Each teacher **will be** expected to participate in at least 50 hours of CPD opportunities every year for their own professional development, driven by their own interests...."*
